parsed.explanation: No active trans-specific visitor restrictions are documented: no criminalisation, presentation offence, facility ban, police targeting, or violence record in this focused legal dossier. Positives include same-sex marriage/adoption recognised under national/top-court law, local legal gender recognition, a January 2023 hate-motivated sentencing law naming gender identity, and a small Pride—supporting an accepting institutional climate. But protections are mainly resident-facing climate signals; there is no comprehensive nondiscrimination statute, limited service recourse, no documented enforcement of the hate-crime law, and border/screening follow unstated national rules, leaving visitor-facing protection evidence thin. Absence of documented harm is only moderately positive, and open questions weigh lightly against known positives but prevent a higher safety rating.
